## Stage 0c: the ratio error sigma_r (sec. 5.0.1)

Units: 81 pairs from `contrast_scores.json` (source 1), 23 answered within-study rows from the contrast benchmark (source 3; 16 censored or duplicate rows skipped); source 2: no group of its own: contrast_scores.json is built from the same rows (build_null_model_baselines._rows) with the same study key, so its groups are source 1's. 16 of 18 groups are out of sample.

Measurement: no source here prints a per-arm SD: each arm takes the declared per-replicate CV (SIDA 10 % where its benchmark's quantification source is isotope dilution, else 20 %) with the unstated n = 2; a contrast-benchmark row that prints sigma_m (a ratio SD) gives each arm sigma_m^2 / 2.
